`paths.ensure_layout(home)` in `src/second_brain/paths.py:125` — it `mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`s every entry of `MAJOR_DIRS` (`paths.py:19`), which is exactly the tuple `doctor.check_layout` (`src/second_brain/doctor.py:73-78`) reports as missing.

Skill dirs in the layout: `skills/active`, `skills/candidates`, `skills/shadow`, `skills/staged`, `skills/approved/{global,domain,project,model}`, `skills/evals`, `skills/quarantine`, `skills/retired`, `skills/principles` (plus `SKILL_LEVEL_DIRS` mapping candidate/shadow/active at `paths.py:104`).

So the code fix is ensuring `cmd_init` calls `ensure_layout` before doctor runs — `cli.py:1558` already does; a fresh home bypassing init (or interrupted before it) is the gap.
